delivered.statement: Credit growth of 12% in FY26, up from 5.5% in FY25
Deposit growth of 14.4%, consistent with historical outpacing of credit
Net income growth of 11%, similar to prior financial year
EPS growth of 10% vs 3% growth in FY25
Core cost-to-income improved to 39.5% from 40.5% prior year
Return on assets stable at 1.9% despite NIM compression
Gross NPAs at 1.15% with 125 basis point provisioning buffer
97% digital adoption for payments/service; 92% for acquisition journeys
100 million customers; acquiring 6-8 million customers annually
47% of incremental deposits <INR 3 crores vs 31% prior year
Business banking grew 20% YoY; #1 in 15 of 28 states
98% of home loan customers opening liability accounts with bank
Liability customer share rose from 36% to 50% in 2.5 years
Mortgage-linked CASA balances grew to INR 86,000 crores from INR 50,000 crores
5 AI use cases in production; 14 more in development pipeline

themes: Operating leverage from 5-6 years tech/digital investment now materializing
Building granular, sustainable retail deposit franchise replacing corporate volatility
In-house unified AI platform enabling rapid agent scaling across org
Accelerating retail credit via wheels, personal loans, mortgages distribution
Defending market leadership in cash management, cards, mortgages, MSME
HDFC merger synergy realization through liability cross-sell and deposit quality
risks: Geopolitical uncertainty could depress corporate demand for couple months ahead
Rate cycle paused with yields rising; NIM recovery trajectory threatened
Time deposit repricing for 5-6 quarters maintains deposit cost pressure
Aggressive growth expansion risks hitting unforeseen balance sheet issues if imprudent
analyst_pushback: Analysts: Why 12% growth < 15% system? Management: System is 13.5-13.9%; we do responsible growth.
Analysts: Is Q4 deposit surge transitory? Management: 47% granular deposits sustainable; corporate volatility natural.
Analysts: Will lower borrowings improve NIM? Management: Yes conditionally; but focus metric is ROA.
Analysts: Is deposit repricing complete? Management: No; time deposits have 5-6 quarters repricing ahead.
tone_evidence: Confident on operational execution; cautious about overextending amid geopolitical and rate uncertainty
